concepts.quote: main() without String[] args is fine because the program uses no arguments.
concepts.why: A main written as public static void main() still compiles, but java Hello then reports that no main method was found, so it is not fine.

concepts.quote: without String[] args is fine because the program uses no arguments
concepts.why: The answer treats the String[] args parameter as optional when no arguments are used, but Java requires it in main's header so the program can be launched.
The answer says nothing about launching or running the program with java Hello.
